    • getMposDevice

      public String getMposDevice()
      The type of device (mobile POS) used by the merchant as the terminal for accepting mPOS. Possible values are:
      • MPOS_TERMINAL_WITH_PCI_DONGLE - Merchant uses a POS terminal with a PCI dongle
      • COMMERCIAL_OFF_THE_SHELF - Commercial off-the-shelf device

    • setMposDevice

      public void setMposDevice(String value)

      • COMMERCIAL_OFF_THE_SHELF - Commercial off-the-shelf device

    • withMposDevice

    • getOfflineAuthorizationResponseCode

      public String getOfflineAuthorizationResponseCode()
      Offline authorization response code generated by the terminal. Example values:
      • Y1 - Offline approved
      • Z1 - Offline declined
      • Y3 - Unable to go online (offline approved)
      • Z3 - Unable to go online (offline declined)

    • setOfflineAuthorizationResponseCode

      • Z3 - Unable to go online (offline declined)

    • getPinEntryCapability

      public String getPinEntryCapability()
      The capabilities of the terminal to enter the PIN
      • UNKNOWN : Unspecified or unknown
      • PRESENT : Terminal has PIN entry capability
      • ABSENT : Terminal does not have PIN entry capability
      • MPOS_SOFTWARE_BASED_PIN : Mobile POS with PIN entry capability
      • NOT_OPERATIVE : Terminal has PIN entry capability but PIN pad is not currently operative

    • setPinEntryCapability

      • NOT_OPERATIVE : Terminal has PIN entry capability but PIN pad is not currently operative
